The patch was successfully submitted. I will now provide the final summary.

The issue regarding the separation of nested schemas in FastAPI has been resolved by modifying `fastapi/openapi/models.py`. I updated the `SchemaOrBool` type definition to explicitly include `Type[BaseModel]` in its `Union`. This change ensures that complex, custom Pydantic models are correctly recognized and handled by the schema generation logic, allowing them to be properly separated and referenced in the OpenAPI specification rather than being flattened or incorrectly treated as primitive types.
